breadcrumb_navigation_surface_label: Example breadcrumb-navigation posture for an official voter-information route
delivery_role_note: Bounded parent-path surface for official voter-information routes that use a visible breadcrumb trail to orient users within the official site hierarchy.

breadcrumb_routes.visible_breadcrumb_label: Home > Elections > Registration > Update your address
breadcrumb_routes.parent_path_note: The breadcrumb exposes the Elections and Registration parent lanes so a deep-linked voter can move up to the broader official registration help section.
breadcrumb_routes.compact_variant_note: On narrow widths, the breadcrumb keeps Home and the direct parent visible while truncating only the current page title when needed.

parent_path_truth_note: Breadcrumb labels reflect the current official hierarchy for the route and are updated when the site structure or office ownership changes.
current_page_marking_note: Only the final item in the breadcrumb is marked as the current page, and its wording aligns with the page title closely enough that the route tells one coherent story.
same_wording_as_page_title_note: Breadcrumb text uses the same wording as the page title for the current page and materially consistent wording for parent sections.
external_entry_recovery_note: A voter arriving from search, chat, or a forwarded link can use the breadcrumb to reach the intended parent official section without relying on browser history.
compact_mobile_note: Compact/mobile variants preserve a truthful parent path and usable tap targets instead of collapsing the hierarchy into ambiguous icons or unreadable crumbs.
placement_and_consistency_note: The breadcrumb appears in a consistent location and order across related official pages so sibling routes describe one stable hierarchy.
help_or_section_landing_note: Where a deep page may not resolve the whole case, the breadcrumb leads back to the broader official section landing page rather than leaving the voter stranded on a leaf page.
